card.name: Inside words before -ial/-ies/-ions endings
card.fires_on: Partway through longer words whose stem is cut just before an ending like -ial, -ies, -ions, -ible or -ed, e.g. ceremon-, afflict-, sub-sid-, neglig-.

modes.label: Ceremony and affliction stems
modes.description: Stem of ceremonial or affliction words, split before the ending.
modes.example: On Mars, the rover Spirit's landing site was<< ceremon>>ially named Columbia Memorial Station.

modes.label: Other split stems
modes.description: Stems of words like subsidies, negligible, discerned, enquirers, cut before a vowel-initial ending.

card.writes: It promotes endings that start with a vowel like -ius, -ium, -iage, and suppresses -ate/-ant/-ation endings.
card.plain: It fires inside a long word when the rest of the word is still to come and will begin with an i or e sound.
